WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.order_id, co.pizza_id) AS row_id,
        co.order_id,
        co.customer_id,
        co.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        co.exclusions,
        co.extras,
        co.order_time,
        pr.toppings AS recipe_toppings
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON co.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        TRY_CAST(trim(split_element) AS BIGINT) AS topping_id
    FROM base b,
    UNNEST(string_split(trim(b.recipe_toppings), ',')) AS t(split_element)
    WHERE b.row_id IN (13, 14)
),
exclusions_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        TRY_CAST(trim(split_element) AS BIGINT) AS exclusion_topping_id
    FROM base b,
    UNNEST(string_split(trim(coalesce(b.exclusions, '')), ',')) AS t(split_element)
    WHERE trim(b.exclusions) IS NOT NULL AND trim(b.exclusions) != '' AND b.row_id IN (13, 14)
),
extras_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        TRY_CAST(trim(split_element) AS BIGINT) AS extra_topping_id
    FROM base b,
    UNNEST(string_split(trim(coalesce(b.extras, '')), ',')) AS t(split_element)
    WHERE trim(b.extras) IS NOT NULL AND trim(b.extras) != '' AND b.row_id IN (13, 14)
),
topping_names AS (
    SELECT topping_id, topping_name FROM pizza_toppings
),
base_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        rte.row_id,
        rte.topping_id,
        tn.topping_name
    FROM recipe_toppings_expanded rte
    LEFT JOIN exclusions_expanded e ON rte.row_id = e.row_id AND rte.topping_id = e.exclusion_topping_id
    LEFT JOIN topping_names tn ON rte.topping_id = tn.topping_id
    WHERE e.exclusion_topping_id IS NULL
),
extra_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        ee.extra_topping_id AS topping_id,
        tn.topping_name
    FROM base b
    JOIN extras_expanded ee ON b.row_id = ee.row_id
    LEFT JOIN topping_names tn ON ee.extra_topping_id = tn.topping_id
    WHERE b.row_id IN (13, 14)
),
all_ingredients AS (
    SELECT * FROM base_ingredients
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM extra_ingredients
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        topping_name,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM all_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, topping_name
)
